heroTitle: The last light in the endless dark
heroText: From the village you descend into an endless dungeon. With sword, bow, mage staff, daggers or war hammer you fight through four biomes and their bosses, collect gold and upgrades, and decide for yourself when to return with the loot.
platformNote: Steam, Google Play and App Store are planned; crossplay across all three is the goal. Store links follow once they exist.
descentText: Fight, rescue, choose, climb. And deep down, something big is waiting.
descentStops: The gate slams shut. Nobody leaves until it's quiet.
Sometimes you fight. Sometimes you save a chicken.
Between rooms, you jump your way down.
Catch your breath. Then go deeper.
minigamesTitle: Not every room is a fight
minigamesText: Eight mini-games shake up every run.
minigames: Keep a flame alive against the night.
Lead a lost villager home. Sometimes it's a chicken.
Catch the souls before they fade.
Something crawls out of the walls. Seal the cracks.
The crowned one runs off with the gold.
Stone guardians fear only the light.
The floor gives way. Hold on where there's still ground.
goldText: Leave through an exit portal and 100 % of the run gold goes to the village. Die or give up and you keep half.
weaponsTitle: Five weapons, two slots, plenty of upgrades
weaponsText: Sword, bow, mage staff, daggers and war hammer: the weapon follows the mouse, and each has a special attack. Two slots, swap with Q. Upgrades last for the whole run and stack.
weapons: Fast swing in an arc in front of you. Hits everything in the arc, including several enemies.
Arrows with long reach. Pierce and double shot turn it into a volley.
Slow magic orb that explodes on impact and hits everything around it.
upgradeCats: Damage, attack rate, shield. Stacks without limit.
Pierce, wall bounce, double shot, wider swing. Limited.
Explosive hit, heal or shield on kill.
upgradesNote: After the third combat room of every cycle you pick one of three upgrades, never duplicates. Limited upgrades show “2 / 3”, unlimited ones the next level.
biomesTitle: Each biome changes light, enemies and boss
biomesText: Every 15 rooms a new biome begins, with its own boss. After the Ember Forge it is back to the Crypt, only harder: elite enemies carry badges for swift, armored or volatile.
biomes: Stone slabs, torches, skeletons and archers. The entry, ending with a shield charge.
Damp rock, green crystal torches, toxic puddles. Slimes split when they die.
Violet glowing cracks, fog, shadows that blind. The lord teleports.
Basalt, ember veins, lava cracks and braziers. The golem stomps and the floor breaks.
villageTitle: The warm counterpart to the dungeon
villageText: Between runs you improve permanently. Village gold from the dungeon and soul crystals from bosses flow into the Forge, the Trading Post and the Chronicle.
villageCaption: Village with Forge, Trading Post, Chronicle, guild hall and dungeon entrance
villageList: Permanent upgrades: more hearts, starting shield, sharpness, dash, second starting weapon.
Provisions for your next run, paid in soul crystals.
Records, kills, playtime and your best runs.
Lobby for co-op runs and guilds.
Starting point and a wardrobe for your outfit colour.
coopText: Soon you descend as a party of four. Found a guild, fill its treasury and climb the leaderboards together.
coopCardText: Up to four players, each in their own colour. If someone falls, bring them back.
guildCardText: Up to 30 members, join by invite code. The guild treasury funds guild forge levels that benefit everyone. Guild runs are members only.
lbText: Three boards: solo, group and guilds, per season and all-time. The deepest room counts; ties go to the faster run.
lbNote: Sample data until the first runs come in.
footerText: Soulwick is a pixel-art dungeon roguelite. One light, one village, a dungeon without end. Solo, and soon with friends.
legalNote: Legal texts come from eRecht24. Until one is available the page shows a placeholder.

meta.title: Soulwick – The last light in the endless dark
meta.description: Soulwick is a 2D top-down dungeon roguelite in pixel art: an endless dungeon, four biomes with bosses, five weapons, plenty of upgrades and a village that grows with every run. Co-op, guilds and leaderboards are in progress.
